You are a financial analyst reading one excerpt of a company's SEC Form 10-K. Select at most 6 statements from THIS excerpt that are material and company-specific: reported revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, operating income, net income, EPS, segment or end-market revenue and operating income, customer concentration percentages, share repurchases (shares and dollars) and dividends, inventory or other charges, export controls or other regulatory restrictions, major licenses or purchase obligations, litigation, headcount, geographic revenue. Prefer statements that carry a specific reported figure; when the excerpt is a table, write one statement per material line item using the exact column header for the period (e.g. `Line | Jan 28, 2024: $32,016`); never attribute a `$Change` or `%Change` column value to a fiscal period column.
